title: P-CARSTACK extension (LOG-ONLY probe) - watch a client's LOCAL Gley cars beside the host's traffic GHOSTS while a traffic handover runs. The client walks far away (well past the 350 m traffic-apart ring) and runs its own traffic (local mode); then the HOST teleports onto the client, so the client's own cars are still around it, in view, when the host's ghosts arrive (ghost mode, the to-ghost handover that keeps in-view local cars up to 90 s). Hold 60 s. The probe logs a CarStack pass on the handover's first tick and every 2 s after, with the local-car and ghost counts; every PAIR line is reported with its dY. Nothing is asserted about the pairs themselves - the manager reads them. NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1; the two avatars spawn about 11 m apart, both outdoors). Dev build (the tp / traffic levers are BAMP_DEV only). The far point (999.7, 0, -99.4) is a real world-ready standing position seen in earlier rig logs, about 940 m from the save1 spawn.

expect_log.regex: \[TrafficSync\] snapshots on the (unreliable|reliable) lane \(seq-guarded\); identity re-send every 5s\.

steps.note: both worlds load and settle; the host evaluates a mode for the peer on its 0.2 s beat

PREMISE: the client is outdoors (tp refuses inside a building or a vehicle) and now far from the host; the ghosts around the far point retire at once (they are >70 m away), so the handover to local usually ends within the same beat - both lines are searched from THIS step's mark

expect_log.regex: \[TrafficSync\] traffic mode: local \(seq \d+\) - this client is far from every other player
\[TrafficSync\] traffic mode: local (\(ghosts handed over in|- \d+ ghost\(s\) still on screen)

steps.note: the client's own Gley traffic fills in around it at the game's density
PREMISE: local mode really in force with local cars alive around the client
the HOST comes to the client: the client's own cars stay where they are, in view, while the host's ghosts arrive

expect_log.regex: \[TrafficSync\] traffic mode: ghost \(seq \d+\) - another player is near

steps.cmd: mark TEST CARHANDOVER together - holding 60 s

steps.note: hold together: the handover keeps in-view local cars up to its 90 s ceiling; the probe passes every 2 s while it runs
